# Pathway Academy Zone
> Specialist Alternative Provision (AP) academy in Stoke-on-Trent supporting young people aged 11–16 with personalised, trauma-informed education.

Pathway Academy Zone (PAZ) provides structured learning environments for students who have become disengaged from mainstream education. Our approach combines academic rigour with therapeutic support and vocational opportunities.

## Contact

- Email: info@pathwayacademyzone.co.uk
- Phone: +44 1782 365365
- Address: Duncalf Street, Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent ST6 3LJ, United Kingdom
- [Make a Referral](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/referral): Referral form for schools, Local Authorities, social workers, and parents.
- Data Protection: dpo@pathwayacademyzone.co.uk

## Services

- [Academic Re-engagement](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/academic-re-engagement): Structured KS3 and KS4 academic curriculum in small groups (max 6) covering English, Maths, Science, PSHE/RSHE, RE, PE and Citizenship.
- [Vocational Learning](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/vocational-learning): Hands-on practical programmes with industry-recognised qualifications and work experience placements.
- [SEMH Support](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/semh-support): Therapeutic intervention for social, emotional and mental health needs, including 1:1 and group sessions and family support.
- [Personal Development](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/personal-development): Communication, problem-solving, team building and goal setting integrated into the weekly timetable.
- [Life Skills Programme](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/life-skills): Practical independence skills including cooking, financial literacy, health and digital/AI skills.
- [Employability Skills](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/employability-skills): CV, interview practice, work experience and careers guidance for Year 10 and 11 students.

## What We Do Not Do

- We are not a Pupil Referral Unit (PRU) and we are not a state-funded school.
- We do not provide residential or boarding placements.
- We do not work with learners outside the 11-16 age range.
- We do not provide therapy in place of CAMHS or clinical mental health services.
- We do not accept self-referrals from young people without parent/carer or commissioner involvement.

## Locations

Stoke-on-Trent (head office). Service areas: Stoke-on-Trent, Newcastle-under-Lyme, Stafford, Cannock, Lichfield, Tamworth, Wolverhampton, Leek and surrounding parts of Staffordshire.
